race.comment: CHARMING DEEL (17) brings the strongest recent form after finishing fourth in a BM66 at Geelong, beaten two and a half lengths, having won a BM62 there the run before from Omnic. The class drop reads well and with any luck getting across from out wide she'll go close. INVISIBLE MAGIC (4) is the main danger, with a strong 1400m record and consecutive placings, most recently second at this track on heavy ground after starting favourite. Hard to beat again. DEALER SING (3) is lightly raced and resumes with upside after winning his Kilmore maiden on soft ground before a plain Bendigo run. Drawn low for Allen who can kick up and his upside appeals. GUNADO (8) has been close enough in stronger BM66 races to be competitive back in this grade on an each-way basis.
